risk: Orphaned Groovy Script and Content Modifier steps (CallActivity_77 and CallActivity_86) not connected to BPMN sequence flow
consequence: Critical business logic for order code validation (YORB, YICB, POR, MNZ, PLM) and OrganizationId header extraction is completely bypassed during runtime, allowing invalid order types to proceed.
mitigation: Unit tests assert exact route execution paths and confirm missing validation logic. Recommendations provide explicit BPMN connectivity adjustments before deploying to QA/Prod.

risk: Message loss due to One-Way SOAP Message Exchange Pattern (MEP) with returnExceptionToSender=false
consequence: Calling systems receive an HTTP 202 Ack before downstream errors or Escalation End (RoutingConditionNotMet) events occur, resulting in silent failures without sender awareness.
mitigation: Automated unit test TC_GLOVIA_003 and TC_GLOVIA_004 assert error state transitions and verify that the Exception Subprocess logs the payload attachment to MPL for monitoring visibility.

risk: Uninitialized / Unbound externalized parameters in gateway condition expressions ({{Glovia_Route_SalesOrder}} and {{Glovia_Route2_ReturnSalesOrder}})
consequence: If tenant configurations lack parameter definitions, condition expressions evaluate to false or cause XPath parsing syntax errors, causing valid messages to land in Escalation End.
mitigation: Test suite explicitly validates boundary evaluation of routing parameters and confirms default path behavior when conditions evaluate to false.

risk: Payload tampering or loss during exception handling in SubProcess_91
consequence: If an error occurs before CallActivity_4 initializes ${in.body} into property.InputPayload, CallActivity_97 overwrites the message body with null, leaving no debug payload for Log_Payload.gsh.
mitigation: Unit test TC_GLOVIA_004 validates that property.InputPayload is safely preserved and restored as an attachment in the error subprocess.
